messages:
mara: Heads-up — planning DDL deploy for payments.events CTAS + incremental backfill tonight 00:30 UTC. Need to avoid long locks; thinking 2-phase apply (create new table, backfill in chunks, swap).

josh: +1. Which shard/region?

mara: Starts in us-east-1 primary, then replicate to eu-west after swap. Backfill is ~120M rows.

oliver: Agree 2-phase. We should run preflight on a canary shard with `pg_dump --schema-only` and `EXPLAIN` on the CTAS query. Also need to pin the migration version in the app deployment so reads don't hit new schema mid-backfill.

jen: What's the planned batch size / parallelism for the backfill? We need to tune so replication lag doesn't spike.

mara: Thinking batches of 10k by id_range, parallelism 6 workers to start, monitor lag. Can start lower if lag bumps.

josh: Also add `statement_timeout = '60s'` for the backfill workers and a retry loop with exponential backoff. If a batch times out we skip and log for manual inspection.

oliver: We should avoid creating indexes before backfill. Create them after swap to avoid overhead. For constraints: add them as NOT VALID then validate post-swap.

jen: Agreed. Constraint plan: 1) CTAS new table without constraints/indexes 2) backfill 3) attach triggers/foreign keys as NOT VALID 4) swap tables 5) validate constraints 6) create indexes.

mara: Sounds good. Deploy window 00:30-02:30 UTC. Please ACK if you can be on-call for the window.

sre-oncall: I can cover the 00:30-01:30 UTC window. Will set up a replication-lag monitor dashboard and alert at 60s lag.

josh: I can be on for the second hour (01:30-02:30 UTC) and handle app-side pinning/unpinning.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by josh for tag `release/payments-ctas-2026-03-20` targeting `staging -> prod` at 00:30 UTC. CI checks: passed.

mara: Quick preflight todo: 
- run `pg_temp_ctas` on staging shard (174.2) with sample 1M rows
- validate backfill script handles gaps and id collisions
- confirm swap is atomic via `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME` in a single tx
- prepare rollback SQL to keep handy

oliver: I'll run the staging preflight at 20:00 UTC and paste results. Expect some VACUUM tuning needed.

jen: Rollback plan notes: if backfill stalls we will keep old table and abort swap. Rollback SQL snippet to restore app routing: `UPDATE app_config SET payments_table = 'payments_events_old' WHERE env='prod';` — keep this in runbook.

mara: Also prepare a fallback plan to cut traffic to fallback model: route 10% of traffic to fallback read replica if swap fails.

josh: For version pinning in the app: deploy with feature flag `payments_ctas_enabled = false` then flip to `true` only after swap + quick smoke tests. Will include a forced-read from new table check before enabling.

oliver: Preflight result (staging): CTAS run 1M sample in 2m14s with peak CPU 45%, replication lag negligible. Backfill script ran 10k batches in ~30s each. No locks observed for reads. Posting logs:

```
2026-03-19T20:05:12Z INFO ctas: started sample CTAS
2026-03-19T20:07:26Z INFO ctas: finished, rows:1000000, time:134s
2026-03-19T20:07:45Z INFO backfill: batch 1..10000 time:32s
2026-03-19T20:18:04Z INFO backfill: batches complete 100/1200
```

jen: Nice. Two questions: 1) how big are the rows avg size? 2) any wide columns that require temp files?

oliver: Avg row ~1.4KB, one JSONB payload but not huge. No temp files in staging run.

mara: Given preflight looks good, decision: proceed with 2-phase tonight. Action items assigned: 
- oliver: run final preflight & capture metrics (complete by 23:00 UTC)
- jen: prepare runbook + rollback SQL in runbook doc (by 23:30 UTC)
- josh: pin migration version in deployment + feature flag toggles (by 23:45 UTC)
- sre-oncall: add monitors & set pager thresholds (by 00:15 UTC)

josh: ACK. I'll include `app_migration_version=20260320-ctas` env var in the deploy and make sure the healthcheck fails if app sees schema mismatch.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `release/payments-ctas-2026-03-20` -> prod at 00:30 UTC. Expected duration: 2h. Contact on-call: @sre-oncall.

mara: One more: when creating NOT VALID constraints post-swap, we'll pace the validations with `concurrent` validation tool to reduce locks. Documenting command:
```
ALTER TABLE payments_events_new ADD CONSTRAINT fk_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) NOT VALID;
-- after swap
ALTER TABLE payments_events_new VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_user;
```

jen: I'll add those commands to the runbook and include a checklist for post-swap smoke tests (queries, tail errors, 5-minute perf check).

oliver: If anything weird happens, immediate rollback steps: stop backfill workers, unpin app (set flag false), do NOT attempt partial swap. Contact DB lead @mara for manual decision.

mara: Thanks team. I'll post a short post-deploy summary in #releases after we finish. :party_parrot:

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks in place. I'll escalate at 90s lag or if >1% error spike.

josh: See you on call.

mara: Closing thread; moving updates to the incident channel during the window if anything pops.
